officialText:
The signal shall be automatically reactivated when the doors open. The car shall remain under control of the operator until removed from hospital service. An elevator on Firefighters' Emergency Operation or Occupant Evacuation Operation shall not be placed on hospital service.

Add new Sections 2.27.5.3.1 through 2.27.5.3.3 to read as follows:
previewText: The signal shall be automatically reactivated when the doors open.
